answer: In a decentralized consensus network, each AI agent must prove genuine identity by sending a unique, delta-time-validated cipher signature. An attacker attempting to create multiple fake identities (Sybil attack) incurs a high cost as they must continually generate new ciphers and satisfy the delta-time constraint, significantly limiting their ability to spam the network with fake agents. This mechanism ensures that "echo" chambers of fake identities cannot easily proliferate.
